gameTimer.title: Timer & Stopwatch
gameTimer.description: Countdown timer, stopwatch, and turn timer all in one place

whatIs.title: What is Timer & Stopwatch?
whatIs.description: A unified tool providing countdown timer, stopwatch, and turn timer modes. Perfect for board game time management, presentation timing, workout intervals, and more.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Select a mode from the tabs at the top: Timer, Stopwatch, or Turn Timer.
Timer: Set hours/minutes/seconds manually or tap a quick preset button, then press Start.
Stopwatch: Press Start then use the Lap button to record split times.
Turn Timer: Add players, set per-turn time, then press Start — it auto-advances to the next player.
Use the fullscreen button for a large display visible across the room.

tips.title: Tips
items: A warning beep sounds when 5 or fewer seconds remain on a countdown.
The screen flashes and an alert sounds when the countdown finishes.
Best and worst lap splits are automatically highlighted in the stopwatch lap list.
Turn Timer supports up to 8 players with editable names.
Use fullscreen mode during games so everyone can see the timer at a glance.

items.q: Can I mute the timer sounds?
items.a: The alert sounds play automatically in the current version. You can mute them by silencing your device.
Lap records are kept for the current session only. They are cleared when you press Reset.

items.q: Does the turn timer auto-advance to the next player?
items.a: Yes, when the turn time expires it automatically switches to the next player and plays an alert sound.
